description: The bar chart illustrates Shapley values for a set of labeled features across multiple multilingual language models, shown as grouped bars per feature. The horizontal axis contains the feature categories ordered left to right as L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, with no explicit axis title; the vertical axis is labeled “Shapley value” and uses a linear scale with tick marks at approximately 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80, spanning roughly from slightly below 0 to about 80. Each category has three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend in the upper right: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and a third model shown in light green (its legend text is obscured). Approximate bar heights by category are: L₄⁺ shows mBERT around 5–6, XLM-R around 6, and the green bar near 0; L₃ shows mBERT near 0–1, XLM-R around 2, and green near 0; L₂ shows mBERT around 4, XLM-R around 5, and green around 1–2; L₁ shows all three near the mid-teens (about 13–15); T shows the tallest bars overall with mBERT near 59–60, XLM-R near 54–55, and green near 79–80; R₁ shows mBERT around 10, XLM-R around 11, and green around 9; R₂ shows small positive bars for mBERT and XLM-R around 2–3 and a slightly negative green bar around −1; R₃ shows values near 0 for mBERT and XLM-R and a slightly negative green bar around −1; and R₄⁺ shows mBERT around 4–5, XLM-R around 5, and a slightly negative green bar around −1. The bars are grouped side-by-side within each category (not stacked), appear in the same left-to-right model order within each group, and there is no visible sorting by magnitude or special visual emphasis beyond the legend and color coding.
